text.content:
The Character Classes

Choose one class. A human may reach level 36 as a fighter, cleric, magic-user or thief; demihumans have lower maximum levels and class restrictions. A class supplies hit dice, attack progression, saving throws, experience requirements, spell access and special abilities.

ClassHit diePrime requisiteMax levelNotes
Clericd8Wisdom36Turn undead; cleric spells
Fighterd10Strength36Weapon mastery; no spells
Magic-Userd4Intelligence36Magic-user spells; read magic
Thiefd6Dexterity36Thief skills; backstab
Dwarfd8Constitution12Fighter abilities; detect tricks
Elfd6Intelligence10Magic-user spells plus fighter abilities
Halflingd6Dexterity8Fighter abilities; hiding and missile bonus

Multiclassing is not used. The optional Druid is an extension of the Cleric: it keeps cleric hit dice, saves and XP, but uses the druid spell list and druid restrictions. The Mystic is an optional variant handled by the DM.
